title: Implement fill trade update and cancel event ingestion into ledger
acceptance_criteria: Each provider event/activity id is applied at most once; a duplicate or re-ingested event after a simulated restart returns DUPLICATE and leaves quantity, cost basis, and reservations unchanged
Partial fills update filled_qty, average fill price, held quantity, and cost basis using cumulative quantities in Decimal; out-of-order partial fills produce the correct final totals
ACCEPTED/PENDING/NEW events never change filled or held quantity
Partial-then-cancel, rejected, canceled zero-fill, and expired orders release exactly the unfilled cash reservation remainder
A fill arriving while an order is CANCEL_PENDING is applied, and the order reaches the correct final state
A sell fill that would take held long quantity below zero records a reconciliation-drift event and blocks new entries rather than creating a silent short
A fill for an unknown client_order_id is persisted as drift/UNMANAGED and blocks entries rather than being dropped
A position cycle closes only when the confirmed remaining quantity is exactly zero
tests/unit/test_fill_processor.py passes without network access or broker credentials
forbidden_changes: edit order_fsm.py, intents.py, coordinator.py, submission.py, broker adapters, or persistence modules
change PLAN_SKELETON.json or any planning artifacts
apply any fill more than once or drop fills for unknown orders
allow held long quantity to go negative silently
place or modify protective stops in this module
use float for money, quantities, or prices
use broker credentials or run broad test suites/backtests
